items.name: is_credential
items.source:
fn is_credential(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let name = path
        .file_name()
        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().to_ascii_lowercase())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    name == ".claude.json"
        || name == "auth.json"
        || name == "oauth_creds.json"
        || name == ".credentials.json"
        || name == "credentials.json"
        || name == ".env"
        || name.contains("secret")
        || name.contains("token")
        || name.contains("keychain")
}
